title: Suggestions — choose before anything changes
intro: Nothing below has been implemented. Pick the items you want; the rest stay as ideas.

rows.suggestion: Choose the base city first (Q1), then limit all tables to that city.
rows.benefit: Removes rows that would not be used for the chosen trip.

rows.suggestion: Fix dates to a 7-night window and show per-night and 7-night totals in one table.
rows.benefit: Allows direct comparison with the 7-night requirement.

rows.suggestion: Add a 'Last verified' date column to every row, with the source URL and a screenshot or archived copy.
Run a manual pass on guide.michelin.com for each starred restaurant (hours, prices, booking link).
Price-track 3–5 shortlisted hotels for 7 nights on the dates chosen, once a month, from now to the trip.
rows.benefit: Gives a real basis for the 'cheapest booking time' answer.

rows.suggestion: Confirm entry route with the embassy: transit (240-hour) vs. L visa vs. Hainan 30-day.
Compare Shanghai with Hainan (30-day visa-free rule for US passports) as a second option.
Add a map view of hotels and restaurants with 60-minute travel rings.
